text:
tara (CS): FYI SummitEdge renewal stuck. Procurement will only pay via PO to SummitEdge UK. Contract currently invoices our US entity. They're also asking to move terms to Net45. Onboarding says workshops won't run until invoices are final. Need quick sync.

mike (AE): Got it. I pushed a 9mo at 7% to keep momentum. Vendor code SE-UK-88; procurement said PO today. I'll request CC fallback for one cycle.

jules (Legal): If invoice entity changes we need a one-page addendum listing SummitEdge UK (VAT 77-889900). Net45 is OK subject to finance signoff for recognition. Draft: "Addendum: Seller will invoice SummitEdge UK (VAT 77-889900). Payment terms Net45 from invoice date."

kevin (Onboarding): Note: trainer booked week of 2026-06-15. If funds aren't posted by 2026-06-10 we need to move workshop to 2026-06-29. We can still do a kickoff call without hands-on labs.

tara (CS): Can procurement attach PO to DocuSign envelope? That usually clears billing. Mike, please forward PO when you have it.

acct-bot: Draft invoice IN-2026-1122 (Net30) created. Will update to Net45 after addendum approval.

mike (AE): PO received PO# UK-SE-2026-444. Uploaded to envelope and asked for CC fallback.

esign-bot: Envelope env-se-2026 created by tara (CS). PO uploaded by mike (AE). Link: https://esign.example/env-se-2026

jules (Legal): Countersigned addendum. tara please route signed addendum + PO to renewals@ and billing@.

acct-bot: Invoice updated to Net45 per approval. New ref IN-2026-1122-01. Accounting note: revenue recognition per addendum. :white_check_mark:

mike (AE): DocuSign completed, customer signed. Procurement said payment processes in 3-5 business days.

kevin (Onboarding): Holding trainer week of 2026-06-15 tentatively. Will confirm after funds post.

tara (CS): Thanks team. I'll capture a short onboarding feedback pulse during week 1. Closing thread.
file_note: Renewal thread: PO to UK entity, Net30->Net45 request, addendum + DocuSign envelope, onboarding workshop hold and fallback.
